parsed.why: Most Protective tier: GENDA plus 2024 constitutional amendment, hate-crimes coverage of gender identity, repealed loitering statute, mandated gender-neutral bathrooms, 2023 shield law covering travelling care-seekers. Only national border/passport and national-custody exposure remains; no state facility exclusion.

Governor's 2023 order fixes sex at birth and backs single-sex spaces; no statewide gender-identity discrimination or hate-crime coverage. Documented custody harm: trans woman celled with a male sex offender, assaulted, all claims dismissed with impunity.

Worst-tier ranking; March 2025 statute recognises only male/female and reaches bathrooms, locker rooms, shelters, dormitories and prisons. No statewide gender-identity protection, 2023 religious-refusal shield, ordinance-nullification and student-outing bills pending.

All government buildings and schools restricted by birth sex, enforced through a public reporting form, with a documentary defence a visitor cannot meet — discovery-engineered universal exposure. Protections omit public accommodations; corrections discrimination documented.

Only state to strip existing gender-identity protections (2025) and to preempt stronger local ordinances; school facility rule expressly binds all on school grounds by birth certificate. Narrower adult facility reach outside schools, but no state-law remedy for a refused visitor.
